faqs.question: What is Sellbar's 32-point electronics quality inspection?
faqs.answer: Every device undergoes exhaustive hardware diagnostic tests including display digitizer uniformity, battery degradation rate, motherboard voltage stability, camera focus calibration, speakers, microphones, and wireless connectivity to ensure 100% functional integrity.

faqs.question: What battery health is guaranteed on this device?
faqs.answer: We guarantee that all refurbished electronics arrive with at least 85% to 100% original battery health capacity. Units with sub-85% health are rejected or fitted with brand-new certified replacement batteries before listing.

faqs.question: How does the 12-Month Doorstep Replacement Warranty work?
faqs.answer: If you encounter any technical, hardware, or motherboard malfunction within 12 months of purchase, simply submit a ticket under your Sellbar account. Our technician will visit your doorstep to inspect, repair, or replace the unit without extra service fees.

faqs.question: What accessories are included inside the box?
faqs.answer: Each device comes packed in our custom eco-friendly tamper-sealed box containing the certified device, a brand new fast-charging data cable, a SIM ejector tool (for cellular devices), a verified 32-point QC certificate, and your 12-month warranty card.
